segment.source: Renders a single onward pointer as one wide card: a small label, the title of what comes next, a sentence of context and a picture. Use it for: the end of a blog post, the last step of a guide pointing at what to do now, a landing page handing off to the next stage, the close of a case study. Prefer 'Previous and Next' when the reader may also want to go back, and 'Related Links' for several suggestions of equal weight.
